text.en: as much as you can. The more you do, better will be the results. / 1   Assignment n°04 in the Google Classroom (DM for feedback) / 2   Revise the vocabulary from this class / 3   Revise the past tense (ta-form), casual/polite & negation / 4   Revise the No & Na-adjectives / 5   Revise “to like/to love” / 6   Revise the demonstrative / 7    Revise the Kanji passively (from Kanji to English idea) / 8    Revise previous lessons / Keep practicing. If you need any help/support, send me / a private message on Discord (@black.moon_).
